derivation: or צָנוֹף; or (feminine) צָנִיפָה; from H6801 (צָנַף);
def: a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around)

occurrences.text: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
